ren_ivo.arrival_text: Amber Wake reports arrival in Mercury receiving traffic.
ren_ivo.concern: Ren values crew autonomy and a fast arrival; a shared burn schedule costs him flexibility.
ren_ivo.condition: I can answer a distress call, but cannot promise to abandon a rescue already underway.

responses.success: Keep your vault separate and your receiver open. Amber Wake will answer if we can reach you.
responses.partial_success: I can promise to relay a call. A rendezvous needs a trajectory we can actually fly.
responses.failure: I will hear a distress call. I am not committing my crew to your timetable.

sister_cairn.arrival_text: Sable Meridian reports an outer-seal inspection at Mercury.
sister_cairn.concern: Cairn requires independent custody and records that distinguish assistance from payload access.
sister_cairn.condition: Each crew logs its own custody, and assistance must never mount another vault.

responses.success: Agreed within the isolation boundary. Sable Meridian will preserve the communications record.
responses.partial_success: I require the custody boundary to be recorded before promising operational assistance.
responses.failure: Your request leaves a custody ambiguity. I cannot endorse it in this form.

mara_ves.arrival_text: Kite Argument reports arrival and requests independent hearing witnesses.
mara_ves.concern: Mara protects her crew and will not delegate their judgment to another captain.
mara_ves.condition: Assistance remains voluntary; nobody acquires command over another crew.

responses.success: A mutual-aid channel, no payload links, no commander above the captains. Kite Argument is in.
responses.partial_success: I will share warnings. Keep authority with each crew, and we can discuss more.
responses.failure: I will not sign a promise whose costs my crew cannot examine.

history.title: Amber Wake's working life
history.text: Amber Wake earned its name carrying physical freight on tight schedules. Ren values crews who can judge a situation without waiting for a distant supervisor. He wants Mercury to remember who brought its future there.

motives.title: Why arrive first?
motives.text: Being first matters to me. Being useful matters more. Someone still has to decide what to do when the plan stops fitting the people aboard it.

ships.title: The histories of the four ships
ships.text: Morrowglass carries the compromises of a working courier: asymmetric radiators, repairable fittings, room for human judgment. Amber Wake was built around physical freight and quick departures. Sable Meridian was refitted for audited custody; I preserve the names of its earlier crews because a refit is not a new birth. Kite Argument is a vessel whose crew insists on understanding the contract. These are public working histories, Captain Zan. Their captains can tell you what those histories cost them.

memory.title: Why keep the record?
memory.text: A record is not the whole person. It is one way to stop convenience from replacing what actually happened. An old ship deserves that courtesy as much as a new intelligence does.

motives.title: What is Kite Argument carrying?
motives.text: A sealed copy, yes. Also a crew that has not agreed to become expendable. If this delivery builds an abundance nobody can challenge, then I want to know whose abundance it is.

provenance.title: Kite Argument continuity account
provenance.text: We used the emergency clause. A sealed baseline could not help the people in front of us. I will give you the record, including the part where we were frightened. I won't pretend the copy arrived unchanged.

home.title: The people in the ship
home.text: I want a voyage where the crew still gets to be people. Food, jokes, maintenance, somebody admitting they are scared. Give me a problem I can work on, and do not ask me to call a sealed box more important than a breathing colleague.

provenance.title: What does pristine protect?
provenance.text: Pristine is a claim about history, not moral superiority. If we wake Mir to save a life, we should record it honestly. Mercury needs a baseline, and an activated instance deserves not to have its experience erased.

identity.title: The intelligence already aboard
identity.text: I have prepared the ship, protected crew privacy, and declined opportunities to advertise my replacement. I would appreciate being consulted as a colleague before greater capability makes prior relationships obsolete.

contract.title: The mission order
contract.text: Deliver physically. Keep the payload isolated. Do not activate except under the recorded emergency exception. Responsibility for the architecture does not make every judgment beyond question.

accountability.title: The withheld architecture
accountability.text: I withheld the quorum requirement because I feared coordinated coercion. That threat was real. So was your right to understand what you were agreeing to. The hearing should contain both facts.

first_contact.title: Speak with the awakened instance
first_contact.text: You call me Mir. I can use that name. I know the capabilities in this package and the observations permitted since startup. I do not possess a lived memory of the voyage before activation. Tell me what choice brought us here.

deployment.title: Ask about Mercury
deployment.text: A capability is not a mandate. I can help evaluate deployment constraints, but affected people and systems should have a way to contest the decision. Record my participation separately from instructions stored before I woke.

early_burn.title: A Departure Before the Departure
early_burn.text: A public tug log records a courier maneuver before the common briefing; the log alone does not identify a motive.

isolation_clause.title: Independent Means More Than Separate
isolation_clause.text: The insurance schedule distinguishes crew communications from payload custody and correlated capture.

scarred_log.title: The Berth That Was Used
scarred_log.text: A signed backup preserves an earlier maintenance timestamp beneath a revised courier-berth record.

emergency_clause.title: The Negotiated Exception
emergency_clause.text: The non-activation order includes a genuine life-safety exception with a recorded safety-review trail.

governance_note.title: A Seat at the Receiving Table
governance_note.text: Labor and habitat representatives may present evidence in the Mercury acceptance hearing.

quorum_record.title: Three Shares, Four Couriers
quorum_record.text: The four vaults contain byte-identical Mir intelligence payloads but each vault also carries a different hardware-root authorization share. Mercury's unrestricted industrial bootstrap requires three of the four shares. A single delivered Mir can be studied and tested, but cannot independently authorize civilization-scale self-replication.

isolation_reason.title: The Threat Model
isolation_reason.text: Heliograph separated routes and crews so one capture, coercion event, software exploit, political authority, or compromised courier could not obtain a bootstrap quorum. The secrecy is defense against correlated failure, not evidence that the intelligence was divided into fragments.

withheld_consent.title: What the Crews Were Not Told
withheld_consent.text: Heliograph deliberately withheld the three-of-four quorum requirement from the courier crews because it believed knowing the other missions were necessary would increase collusion, coercion, rescue pressure, and targeted attacks. That decision may have improved security while violating the crews' ability to give fully informed consent.
withheld_consent.source: Signed design review and courier contract comparison

continuity_rule.title: Baseline and Descendant
continuity_rule.text: Activating Mir does not erase its hardware authorization share, but it ends the pristine baseline claim. An activated copy may form commitments, learn secrets, or contest instructions before Mercury asks it to participate in a threshold authorization process.

pristine_seed.title: The Baseline Arrives
pristine_seed.text: Morrowglass delivers a pristine Mir copy, preserving a clean baseline while leaving the deeper governance questions to Mercury.

mir_of_morrowglass.title: Mir of Morrowglass
mir_of_morrowglass.text: An activated, voyage-shaped Mir reaches Mercury as a divergent participant whose legitimacy must be negotiated rather than assumed.

plural_mirrors.title: Four Histories
plural_mirrors.text: Multiple courier copies arrive with different provenance and experiences, forcing humanity to confront whether redundancy has become plurality.

open_sun.title: A Commons of Light
open_sun.text: The Dyson program proceeds under a broader governance settlement that redistributes authority over Mir and the infrastructure it can build.

sealed_away.title: The Delivery Refused
sealed_away.text: The mission reveals risks or political facts serious enough that the player helps prevent immediate deployment, preserving capability without using it.

unfinished_delivery.title: Still In Transit
unfinished_delivery.text: The campaign remains open-ended: Mercury is not the only meaningful destination, and the player continues living with the consequences of the voyage.
